correctness.rationale: The physical transfer is zG and z multiplication is isometric in H2. Kernel projection over every complex pole gives captured squared norm 4a²(1-|lambda|²)/|1-t lambda²|². Reverse triangle inequality forces lambda real at any nonzero optimal radius; the derivative of 4a²(1-s)/(1-ts)² has sign 2t-1-ts. This proves uniqueness at zero for t<=1/2 and exactly ±sqrt(2-1/t) for t>1/2, residue a/t, sharp squared error, saddle Hessian and quartic threshold. Independently checked derivative, t=3/4 rational example and excess formula. The script verify.py is supplementary; no finite sampling is treated as proof.
